propositions: Bridge runner must be portable across local, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and bare environments through a single packaged Python entrypoint without requiring repository-local scripts
Legacy reconcile workflows and checked-out environments using --mode vocabulary must retain their existing behavior, defaults, exit codes, and messages without breaking changes
Destructive-repair pause ownership must be provider-neutral and use only git refs and durable CAS semantics without depending on GitHub CLI or other CI provider tools
The no-GitHub-CLI constraint is proven by test_repair_pause_ownership.py rejecting subprocess calls beginning with 'gh' while executing repair successfully

Both children (runner-neutral bridge entrypoint plus wrappers, and provider-neutral pause ownership) are independently releasable and preserve existing signatures, mutation boundaries, and output compatibility
